root.label: Aaron Farinacci arrested and charged in Old Trails fire

events.label: Aaron Farinacci arrested and charged in Old Trails fire

slots.name: maximum fine
slots.sentence: On Monday, Mr. Farinacci was arrested and charged with one count of first-degree arson, which is punishable by up to life in prison and a $50,000 fine upon conviction.

slots.name: bond amount
slots.sentence: He is being held on a $1 million bond.

slots.name: prior fires
slots.sentence: Court documents show that Mr. Farinacci had been investigated in connection with two fires in Washington last summer, but he was not arrested in either case.

slots.name: bond status
slots.sentence: A judge kept the bond and said that Mr. Farinacci could not be in possession of any lighters, matches, torches or fire-starting devices if the bond were posted.

slots.name: first court appearance date
slots.sentence: Mr. Farinacci made his first court appearance on Tuesday afternoon.

slots.name: defense lawyer
slots.sentence: Colin Charbonneau, the director of the county public defender’s office, said that he represented Mr. Farinacci during Tuesday’s hearing and that a lawyer in his office would likely be assigned to represent Mr. Farinacci starting Wednesday.
